placements.title: Rollback capability exists only when actively rehearsed
placements.frame: What operational cadence and verification practices are required for a rollback procedure to constitute genuine readiness?
placements.why: Quinton mandates monthly Atlas rollback rehearsals (src-1) and frames the underlying principle that an unrehearsed rollback does not functionally exist (src-2), establishing that operational recovery mechanisms require regular rehearsal to be considered real capabilities.
